footAnchor: Source footprint/visible and occluded feet support projection; never automatic lowest opaque pixel. Beak and rear tail can project below feet.
runtimeGate: Play only after actual successful grounded consumption from the original finite food/corpse source; selecting a target, looking for food, a failed attempt or merely elapsed visual time does not qualify.
gameTime: 1800ms is presentation only. Do not advance TU, create kcal, split carcasses, gather new materials, reroll habitat supply or bypass food/body capacity from the renderer.
direction: Retain actual feeding direction for the cue. Do not rotate the rear pose to invent a visible beak. Moving/attacking/hurt/fall/sleep interrupts or replaces work appropriately.
combatSeparation: Existing attack clip remains the actual hostile eye-peck action. Unconscious-target restrictions, damage and face cover are core rules; do not animate ordinary feeding as successful eye attack.
artLimit: Grounded folded-wing work only. No flight, circling, courier equipment or new species prepared in this bundle.
feathers: Item.CrowFeathers uses existing av331_crow_feathers sprite. The icon depicts a small bundle only; original finite harvest/butchery rules determine count, not depicted feather count.
integrationPrecondition: Merge the existing v334 av331_ash_crow character definition before applying character-work.patch.json. The patch adds only work and its16 transforms; it does not replace the112 existing crops.
releaseAcceptancePending: Actual core feeding, interruptions, visibility, lighting, scale and occlusion must be reviewed after parent integration. Staging canvas is not game acceptance.
